commit.message:
feat(runtime,web): MSAL auth-redirect for /web

Wires the existing lobster_web MSAL plumbing (services/msalAuth.ts +
__LOBSTER_RUNTIME_CONFIG__.msal placeholders in index.html) through to
the runtime so signed-in users actually flow:

  1. User loads /web -> runtime substitutes __LOBSTER_MSAL_CLIENT_ID__
     and __LOBSTER_MSAL_AUTHORITY__ in index.html from env vars
     (Config::msal). With env unset the placeholders survive verbatim
     and the bundle's IIFE skips MSAL init -- intended local-dev default.
  2. Bundle calls loginRedirect, AAD redirects to /auth/callback with
     the response in the URL fragment.
  3. /auth/callback returns a tiny HTML bouncer that runs
     window.location.replace('/web/' + search + hash). Browser preserves
     the fragment across the replace so MSAL's handleRedirectPromise()
     consumes it on the /web/ side.
  4. TopNav shows a "Sign in" button when runtimeConfig.signIn is wired
     and no MSAL account is present; switches to the account name once
     handleRedirectPromise resolves (250ms poll for up to 5s).

Layer breakdown:

  Runtime (Rust/axum):
    - Config + MsalConfig parse LOBSTER_MSAL_CLIENT_ID + AUTHORITY
      from env. Authority defaults to /organizations (any AAD org)
      per the feature design.
    - routes::web::serve_index reads index.html per request and does
      .replace() on the two placeholders when MSAL is set.
    - routes::web::auth_callback returns the bouncer HTML.
    - /web/{*rest} catch-all dispatches index.html vs static asset.
      Owning the dispatch in one handler avoids axum 0.8's "route +
      nest_service overlap" panic and the "nested route("/") +
      fallback_service" 404-on-prefix-root pitfall.

  EV2 deploy:
    - chart/values.yaml exposes LOBSTER_MSAL_{CLIENT_ID,AUTHORITY} as
      platformEnvVariables tokenized to #msalClientId# / #msalAuthority#.
    - ApplicationParameters.json supplies values per ClusterCategory:
      Dev/Test/Preprod  -> TEST-Lobster (044097e5-...)
      FirstRelease/Prod -> Lobster      (f1217e17-...)
      Authority everywhere -> /organizations.

  Web (lobster_web):
    - App.tsx adds <SignInWidget/> to <TopNav/>. Hidden when MSAL is
      not wired. Button triggers runtimeConfig.signIn(); name display
      reads _getMsalInstance().getActiveAccount() with a short poll
      to catch handleRedirectPromise resolving after boot.

  Local dev:
    - dev-start.sh logs whether MSAL is on/off; vars are unset by
      default so MSAL stays off. Comment block documents the opt-in.
    - docs/authentication-redirect-uris.md updated: TBD-CALLBACK-PATH
      replaced everywhere with /auth/callback, plus a new "Local dev"
      section documenting http://localhost:8443/auth/callback.

Tests:
    - 4 new routes::tests cases (auth_callback bouncer; /web/ placeholder
      pass-through when MSAL unset; substitution when MSAL set; static
      asset fall-through with placeholder NOT substituted). Plus 4
      config::tests cases for MSAL env-var parsing edge cases. All
      137 lib + 11 integration tests pass locally.

Smoke-tested against `docker run -e LOBSTER_MSAL_CLIENT_ID=... lobster:dev`:
    - GET /web/ returns substituted clientId in the served HTML.
    - GET /web/ (no env) leaves __LOBSTER_MSAL_CLIENT_ID__ verbatim.
    - GET /auth/callback returns 200 with the bouncer script.
    - GET /web/static/js/index.<hash>.js returns 200 (246KB chunk
      via ServeDir fall-through).

Out of scope (follow-ups):
    - Submit /auth/callback redirect URIs to AAD-FirstPartyApps repo
      for both TEST-Lobster (044097e5) and Lobster (f1217e17) regs.
    - Add http://localhost:8443/auth/callback to TEST-Lobster.
    - Acquire API tokens for aether runtime calls (this PR is sign-in
      only -- openid/profile only).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(runtime,web): address Copilot review feedback on auth-redirect PR

- SignInWidget polling: use functional setAccount with localAccountId
  comparison to avoid unnecessary re-renders when account is null
- auth_callback: add Content-Security-Policy header (default-src 'none',
  script-src 'unsafe-inline') to lock down the OAuth bouncer page
- config: validate MSAL env vars reject HTML-special chars (<, >, ", ')
  at parse time to prevent injection via misconfigured env vars
- web.rs: replace internal "lobster-runtime: ..." error messages with
  generic "Unable to serve page" for external-facing responses
- config tests: add msal_rejects_html_special_chars_in_client_id and
  msal_rejects_html_special_chars_in_authority test cases

refactor(web): reuse existing sign-in controls instead of duplicating in TopNav

Remove the standalone "Sign in" button from the TopNav SignInWidget.
The pre-sign-in affordance is already provided by the CapabilityBanner
(on non-landing routes) and the LandingPage's inline "Sign in to use
Lobster" button (on the / route). The TopNav widget now only renders
the account display name after sign-in, acting purely as an identity
indicator rather than a duplicate sign-in trigger.

Addresses harryf's review comment on PR #634.
